annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于印发国务院2021年度立法工作计划的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the State Council on Issuing the State Council's 2021 Legislative Work Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council of China)
annotation.venue: 中国政府网 / State Council Gazette
annotation.summary_en: China's State Council 2021 legislative work plan, listing laws and administrative regulations to be drafted or revised. It has no AI-specific content. Items of tangential relevance include the Interim Regulations on Unmanned Aircraft Flight Management, the Data Security regulation and the Critical Information Infrastructure protection regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Plans drafting of Interim Regulations on Unmanned Aircraft Flight Management (Central Military Commission Joint Staff Dept and Ministry of Transport)
Plans Data Security Management Regulations and Critical Information Infrastructure Security Protection Regulations
Lists 18 draft laws for NPC Standing Committee review and 28 administrative regulations
Sets requirements for Party leadership, legislative quality, and filing review of regulations
